ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: In matched_ignore, when joining the absolute parent base with the search path, the prefix-stripping logic could strip a leading '.' from a hidden filename (e.g. '.foo.txt') when the parent ig.0.dir was '.'. Fix adds an early bail-out when ig.0.dir == Path::new('.') so hidden whitelisted files remain matchable when searched via '.' or './'.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'ignore: fix problem with searching whitelisted hidden files' and body: 'when the whitelist comes from a parent gitignore file... we need to strip the parent path... but getting this stripping correct seems to be a subtle affair. Fixes #3173'. Regression test r3173_hidden_whitelist_only_dot exercises searches with no arg, '.', and './' from both repo root and subdir against a whitelisted '.foo.txt'. CHANGELOG entry 'Fix ancestor ignore filter bug when searching whitelisted hidden files.'

ai_baseline.notes: Items 1 and 2 directly name assumption_boundary on the new exact == Path::new('.') guard and the empty-prefix edge when ig.0.dir is './'. Item 3 is a supporting test-gap note. Matches the real fix mechanism from diff alone; reviewer could request a './' equivalence-class test.
